claim: Literature-anchored prefracture surrogate and numerical loading experiment; no calibrated biological growth or fracture claim
cohort_construction: Three perfectly bonded uniform radial stocks; all exist initially, initially stress free. These are retained-cohort proxies, not annual birth events.
loading: F_elastic = F_total A(s), A = I + s beta t tensor t; s ramps 0 to 1. Fixed reference gradients, weights, density and mass. Natural tangential eigenstrain is 1/(1+s beta)-1. This is externally imposed retained mismatch, not deposition.
boundary: All three displacement components fixed on innermost radial surface; all other exterior surfaces traction free
fracture: Disabled: continuous conforming volume and exact shared cohort nodes. No birth-interface adhesion, fracture energy, or postpeak constitutive branch is assigned.
evidence_caveat: Tangential table anchors are class-1 subgroup means from processed cork. Compression means are different specimens and conditions. Assigning subgroups to cohorts, zero Poisson coupling, the knee, other tensile moduli, shear, plateau, density, geometry and mismatch are explicit assumptions. K_Ic values are not converted into Gc.
